responsibility: This file defines GCC’s compiled-in version identity strings. It assembles and exports the complete compiler version string from build-time macros, the configured package-version string, and the bug-report URL that diagnostics and version-reporting code present to users. Its responsibility is to provide concrete storage for version metadata declared in version.h.
same_name_distinction: Defines and allocates the actual exported version metadata strings from build-time macros, including version_string, pkgversion_string, and bug_report_url; version.h only declares these extern symbols for other files to use.
